subject: Event planning
body:
2026-10-25T16:15:00+01:00 — Elena Wolf: Nora, I can collect reusable decorations after the Bash. But I saw my name under everything to clear, which is quite a promotion.
2026-10-25T16:15:58+01:00 — Nora Stein: I'll narrow the task. Dina is right that we had lots of cutters and hangers and almost nobody for the end.
2026-10-25T16:17:05+01:00 — Elena Wolf: And keep sticky things off painted walls. The reusable box contains some very permanent-looking adhesive.
2026-10-25T16:18:23+01:00 — Nora Stein: Kofi asked for door glass and routes to stay clear too. I'll put that beside the layout, not buried in the invitation.
2026-10-25T16:19:46+01:00 — Elena Wolf: How are receipts going? Ines's carrier-bag speech was memorable.
2026-10-25T16:20:50+01:00 — Nora Stein: Uma has an envelope at reception. I'm matching purchases to the committee sheet so Finance doesn't get a pile of mysteries.
